svg.title: Yellow Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the actual viewed reference. Approximate observed geometry and standardized color families; wall, shadows, thickness and texture omitted. Tate’s exact T07403 collection page supplied the full official image, viewed and downloaded through its ordinary public image element. Three yellow edges are visible: nearly horizontal top, long sloping left and gently bowed right. The source photograph is slightly oblique. Current Tate details still report support 1357 × 3556 × 32 mm, in conflict with the tall observed support. No dimension swap, physical-size correction or identity with another Yellow Curve is inferred. Study keeps the observed support proportions and is excluded from true-scale plotting.
